title: DXF XDATA APPID admission allocation rollback
scope: Direct dxfRW APPID preflight admission and the shared transactional set insertion used by preflight and typed XDATA emission.
implementation: Stage only newly required APPID keys before mutating the codec's required set.
Reserve the destination set before inserting keys; if any insertion throws, erase all keys staged by this admission and preserve pre-existing requirements.
Catch allocation failures in preflight vector construction and group validation so they return refusal rather than escape the API.

control.encodings: ASCII direct preflight; insertion logic is encoding-independent
control.each_failure: The operation refuses, the prior EXISTING requirement remains, neither new key remains, and a fresh codec admits both keys successfully.
control.success_boundary: The next calibrated offset completes admission with exactly all three required keys.

limitations: The allocation sweep directly exercises preflight admission; it does not inject failures during later DXF record serialization.
The failing codec retains the writer's existing sticky-error behavior; recovery is verified with a fresh codec.
No producer or format-support claim changes.
